source: AI Video Bootcamp Phase 3 'Style Reference Library' (AVB_Style_Reference_Library_clean.pdf) - 24 visual styles, each with the look, when to reach for it, and an example prompt. The course's own rule: add the style keywords at the END of the prompt, after the scene description, never lead with them. Version 2 added 2 `photoreal` entries (`iphone-ugc-realism`, `on-camera-flash-candid`) sourced from community UGC/avatar prompt-bank material, not the course PDF - each says so via its own `source` field. Version 3 adds 1 more `photoreal` entry, `universal-realism-lock`, sourced from a DIFFERENT official course lesson ("Removing the 'AI' Look", not the Style Reference Library PDF) - its `source` field says so. Version 4 refines the existing `tilt-shift` entry's `keywords`/`look`/`when`/`example` using community reference material identifying the two details that actually drive the miniature illusion (a high angle looking down, and a specific top/bottom-heavy sharp-middle blur shape, not generic shallow depth of field) - its own `source` field says so; no new style added, still 27 total.
note: Two groups. `photoreal` styles are compatible with the 8/8 realism gate - they describe a real camera/film/lighting look. `stylised` styles deliberately are NOT photographic (anime, oil painting, watercolour); applying one drops the realism score on purpose, the same way tools/story_bank.json's animated look does, and the Style section warns before it is applied. `keywords` is the phrase that gets appended (spec['overrides']['style'], folded into the free extra segment by build_prompt.free_overrides). `custom` typed text always beats a picked style. `photoreal` now holds the course's original 14, 2 community-sourced additions, and 1 more addition from a different course lesson (each addition says which via its own `source` field) - 27 styles total, still 10 `stylised`.

35mm-film.label: 35mm film
35mm-film.keywords: shot on 35mm film, warm tones, natural grain, slightly soft focus, organic colour shifts
35mm-film.look: Warm tones, natural grain, slightly soft focus, the look of analog photography.
35mm-film.when: When you want a timeless, nostalgic, 'this feels real' quality.
35mm-film.example: A couple walking through a flea market on a Sunday morning, the woman holding a vintage vase she just found, shot on 35mm film

polaroid.label: Polaroid
polaroid.keywords: taken on a Polaroid instant camera, square format, faded colours, soft warm tones, slight vignette, white border frame
polaroid.look: Square format, faded colours, slight vignette, soft warm tones, white border.
polaroid.when: Instant nostalgia - casual, personal, intimate moments.
polaroid.example: Friends sitting on a rooftop at sunset passing around drinks, someone laughing, taken on a Polaroid camera

cinematic-widescreen.label: Cinematic widescreen
cinematic-widescreen.keywords: cinematic widescreen 2.39:1, shallow depth of field, dramatic lighting, colour graded
cinematic-widescreen.look: 2.39:1 frame, shallow depth of field, dramatic lighting, graded colour.
cinematic-widescreen.when: Hero shots, establishing shots, anything that needs to feel like a movie.
cinematic-widescreen.example: A lone figure walking through a bamboo forest in the rain, cinematic widescreen, moody lighting

film-noir.label: Film noir
film-noir.keywords: film noir, high-contrast black and white, dramatic shadows, venetian-blind lighting
film-noir.look: High-contrast black and white, hard shadows, venetian-blind light.
film-noir.example: A detective standing under a streetlight in an empty alley, cigarette smoke rising, film noir, black and white, dramatic shadows

vintage-magazine.label: Vintage magazine
vintage-magazine.keywords: styled like a 1960s magazine editorial, warm muted tones, fine grain, clean composition
vintage-magazine.look: Clean composition, warm muted tones, grain, 1960s editorial styling.
vintage-magazine.when: Fashion content, lifestyle brands, retro-inspired projects.
vintage-magazine.example: A woman in a trench coat walking through a Paris street market, styled like a 1960s magazine editorial

editorial-fashion.label: Editorial fashion
editorial-fashion.keywords: editorial fashion photography, high-end styling, a dramatic pose, controlled directional lighting, magazine quality
editorial-fashion.look: High-end styling, dramatic poses, controlled light, magazine quality.
editorial-fashion.when: Fashion brands, luxury products, high-end social content.
editorial-fashion.example: Model in an oversized blazer standing in an empty white studio, strong directional light from the left, editorial fashion photography

street-photography.label: Street photography
street-photography.keywords: candid street photography, a real-world setting, raw, a decisive moment caught, natural light
street-photography.look: Candid, urban, raw, the decisive moment, real-world setting.
street-photography.when: Authentic-feeling content, urban stories, real-world scenes.
street-photography.example: A delivery driver checking his phone on a busy corner, steam rising from a manhole, golden hour, street photography

drone-photography.label: Drone photography
drone-photography.keywords: aerial drone photography, a bird's-eye perspective, strong patterns seen from above, a sense of scale
drone-photography.look: Aerial perspective, patterns from above, a sense of scale.
drone-photography.when: Landscapes, architecture, revealing scale and pattern.
drone-photography.example: Aerial view of a winding coastal road along turquoise cliffs, a tiny white car on the road, drone photography

macro-photography.label: Macro photography
macro-photography.keywords: extreme macro photography, incredible fine detail on a tiny subject, very shallow depth of field
macro-photography.look: Extreme close-up, huge detail on tiny subjects, shallow depth.
macro-photography.when: Product details, nature, textures - anywhere detail matters.
macro-photography.example: A single drop of water on a green leaf with the forest reflected in the droplet, macro photography

long-exposure.label: Long exposure
long-exposure.keywords: long-exposure photograph, motion blur on the moving elements, sharp static elements, light trails
long-exposure.look: Motion blur on moving elements, sharp static elements, light trails.
long-exposure.when: Night cityscapes, waterfalls, traffic - motion in a still image.
long-exposure.example: A waterfall in a forest with smooth silky water from a long exposure, mossy rocks, peaceful and serene

tilt-shift.label: Tilt-shift miniature
tilt-shift.keywords: tilt-shift miniature photography, shot from a high angle looking down at the scene, heavy blur at the top and bottom of the frame with a sharp focus band across the middle, oversaturated colours, the scene made to look like a hand-built miniature diorama
tilt-shift.look: Shot from above looking down, heavy blur top and bottom with a sharp focus band across the middle, oversaturated colours - real scenes read as tiny hand-built dioramas.
tilt-shift.when: Making an ordinary wide scene (a street, an office, a warehouse) look like a miniature model. Only works shot from a high angle looking down - eye-level photos will not convert; a generic shallow depth of field will not either, the blur has to be that specific top/bottom-heavy, sharp-middle shape.
tilt-shift.example: A busy intersection seen from a high angle looking down, tilt-shift miniature photography, heavy blur at the top and bottom of the frame with a sharp focus band across the middle, oversaturated colours, the cars and people look like a tiny hand-built diorama
tilt-shift.source: Community reference material (a tilt-shift/miniature prompting note), not the course PDF - refines the course's own tilt-shift entry with the two details that actually drive the illusion.

golden-hour-portrait.label: Golden hour portrait
golden-hour-portrait.keywords: golden hour portrait, warm backlight, golden skin tones, a gentle sun flare, magic-hour glow
golden-hour-portrait.look: Warm backlight, golden skin tones, sun flare, magic-hour glow.
golden-hour-portrait.when: Portraits, lifestyle, any content that needs warmth and beauty.
golden-hour-portrait.example: A woman laughing with her eyes closed in a wheat field, golden hour backlight catching her hair, warm and joyful

studio-lighting.label: Studio lighting
studio-lighting.keywords: clean studio lighting, controlled and dramatic, a seamless background, a professional product-photography look
studio-lighting.when: Product photography, headshots, clean brand content.
studio-lighting.example: A pair of white sneakers on a clean grey background, soft studio lighting, a slight shadow underneath

double-exposure.label: Double exposure
double-exposure.keywords: a double-exposure effect, a portrait blended with a landscape, moody and atmospheric
double-exposure.look: Two images blended into one - usually a portrait merged with nature.
double-exposure.when: Creative portraits, symbolic storytelling, artistic social content.
double-exposure.example: A woman's silhouette filled with a mountain forest landscape, double exposure effect, moody and atmospheric

iphone-ugc-realism.label: iPhone / UGC realism
iphone-ugc-realism.keywords: shot on a smartphone rear camera, natural available light, visible skin pores and micro-texture, no beauty filter, slight phone-camera softness, authentic unfiltered UGC style
iphone-ugc-realism.look: Natural phone-camera imperfections, visible skin texture, no filter, candid unposed framing.
iphone-ugc-realism.when: UGC ads, influencer content, anything that needs to read as user-generated rather than a produced shoot.
iphone-ugc-realism.example: A woman holding an iced coffee in a parked car, glancing at her phone, shot on a smartphone rear camera, natural available light
iphone-ugc-realism.source: Community reference material (candid smartphone/UGC prompt patterns), not the course PDF.

on-camera-flash-candid.label: On-camera flash candid
on-camera-flash-candid.keywords: raw on-camera flash photography, blown highlights, deep hard shadows, slight motion blur, unpolished paparazzi-style candid
on-camera-flash-candid.look: Harsh direct flash, blown highlights, hard shadows, spontaneous unplanned energy.
on-camera-flash-candid.when: Nightlife, candid street or party moments, deliberately raw non-cinematic realism.
on-camera-flash-candid.example: Two friends laughing outside a gas station at night, caught off guard, raw on-camera flash photography, blown highlights
on-camera-flash-candid.source: Community reference material (paparazzi-style flash-photography prompt patterns), not the course PDF.

universal-realism-lock.label: Universal realism lock
universal-realism-lock.keywords: authentic everyday photorealism, muted true-to-life colours, low contrast, believable exposure, imperfect composition, natural body language, no glamour retouching, no cinematic colour grading, no hyper-polished AI look
universal-realism-lock.look: Deliberately unglamorous and ungraded - flat true-to-life colour, low contrast, ordinary framing, nothing about it reads as art-directed.
universal-realism-lock.when: Any photoreal generation where the risk is looking too polished or too 'cinematic' rather than not realistic enough - a general-purpose fix for the fake AI look, not tied to one camera or setting the way iPhone/UGC realism is.
universal-realism-lock.example: A man reading a letter at his kitchen table on an ordinary afternoon, authentic everyday photorealism, muted true-to-life colours, low contrast, believable exposure
universal-realism-lock.source: AI Video Bootcamp's "Removing the 'AI' Look" lesson - its own "Universal Realism" prompt add-on, condensed. Unlike the two community-sourced entries above, this one IS from an official course lesson.

anime-manga.label: Anime / manga
anime-manga.keywords: anime and manga style, clean linework, vibrant colours, expressive characters, a stylised background
anime-manga.look: Clean lines, vibrant colours, expressive characters, stylised backgrounds.
anime-manga.when: Character design, fantasy scenes, anything that needs an animated look.
anime-manga.example: A girl sitting on a rooftop overlooking a neon-lit futuristic city at night, anime style, vibrant colours

oil-painting.label: Oil painting
oil-painting.keywords: in the style of a classical oil painting, visible brush strokes, rich colours, dramatic light
oil-painting.look: Visible brush strokes, rich colours, dramatic light, classical composition.
oil-painting.when: Fantasy, historical, dramatic or epic scenes.
oil-painting.example: A stormy seascape with a small sailing ship, dramatic clouds, in the style of a classical oil painting

watercolor.label: Watercolour
watercolor.keywords: painted in soft watercolour, soft edges, transparent washes of colour, white paper showing through
watercolor.look: Soft edges, transparent washes of colour, white paper showing through, dreamy.
watercolor.when: Gentle, delicate subjects - nature, florals, soft portraits.
watercolor.example: A field of wildflowers with a small cottage in the distance, morning mist, painted in soft watercolour

pencil-sketch.label: Pencil sketch
pencil-sketch.keywords: a detailed pencil sketch on cream paper, graphite, varying line weight, cross-hatched shadows
pencil-sketch.look: Graphite on paper, varying line weight, cross-hatching for shadows, raw.
pencil-sketch.when: Concept art, architectural studies, character design, raw creative energy.
pencil-sketch.example: An old man's face with deep wrinkles, detailed pencil sketch on cream paper, expressive eyes

pop-art.label: Pop art
pop-art.keywords: bold pop art style, bright primary colours, thick outlines, halftone dots, high contrast
pop-art.look: Bold primary colours, thick outlines, halftone dots, high contrast.
pop-art.when: Bold statements, brand content, playful and eye-catching.
pop-art.example: A woman drinking coffee with a surprised expression, bold pop art style, bright primary colours, comic-book dots

dark-academia.label: Dark academia
dark-academia.keywords: dark academia aesthetic, muted browns, warm candlelight, old books, classical architecture
dark-academia.look: Muted browns, warm candlelight, old books, classical architecture.
dark-academia.when: Education content, literary vibes, an intellectual aesthetic.
dark-academia.example: A stack of old leather-bound books on a mahogany desk, reading glasses on top, candlelight, dark academia aesthetic

vaporwave.label: Vaporwave
vaporwave.keywords: vaporwave aesthetic, neon pink and blue, glitch effects, a retro-futuristic 80s digital look, a glowing grid floor
vaporwave.look: Neon pink and blue, glitch effects, retro-futuristic 80s digital.
vaporwave.when: Bold social content, music-related, nostalgic-futuristic branding.
vaporwave.example: A retro computer setup with neon pink and blue lighting, a palm tree in the background, vaporwave aesthetic, glowing grid floor

cottagecore.label: Cottagecore
cottagecore.keywords: a soft cottagecore aesthetic, soft natural light, meadows and wildflowers, linen, handmade, pastoral
cottagecore.look: Soft natural light, meadows, flowers, linen, handmade, pastoral.
cottagecore.when: Lifestyle brands, natural products, wellness, food content.
cottagecore.example: A woman in a linen dress picking wildflowers in a sun-drenched meadow, a wicker basket, soft cottagecore aesthetic

cyberpunk.label: Cyberpunk
cyberpunk.keywords: cyberpunk aesthetic, neon-lit rain-slicked streets, holographic advertisements, a tech-heavy dystopia
cyberpunk.look: Neon-lit dystopia, rain-slicked streets, holographic ads, tech-heavy.
cyberpunk.when: Sci-fi content, tech brands, futuristic storytelling.
cyberpunk.example: A street vendor selling noodles under a neon sign in a rainy cyberpunk alley, holographic advertisements reflecting in puddles

minimalist.label: Minimalist
minimalist.keywords: minimalist, clean and simple, generous negative space, a single focal point, soft even lighting
minimalist.look: Clean, simple, lots of negative space, one focal point.
minimalist.when: Clean brand content, modern design, luxury - when less is more.
minimalist.example: A single red chair in the centre of a vast white room, soft even lighting, minimalist, clean

emotive-sketch.label: Emotive sketch
emotive-sketch.keywords: a fine-linework sketch illustration, delicate strokes and thoughtful shading, soft natural light, a quiet natural setting behind
emotive-sketch.look: Fine linework and delicate shading rather than a hard graphite medium, softly lit, calm and reflective.
emotive-sketch.when: When the FEELING is the brief rather than the medium - a quiet, intimate subject in a natural setting. Pick pencil-sketch instead when you want visible graphite on paper.
emotive-sketch.example: A woman sitting alone on a wooden bench in late autumn, a fine-linework sketch illustration, delicate strokes and thoughtful shading, soft natural light through the leaves behind her
